item.title: ATHLETE OF THE WEEK: Breanna Bragg, Manteca wrestling
item.description: The 110-pound freshman went 6-1 in the Sac-Joaquin Section Wrestling Championships on Friday and Saturday, finishing third and earning a trip to the California State Wrestling Championships beginning Thursday in Bakersfield.

item.title: ROUNDUP: Wilkins’ late double lifts Manteca to softball win over Kimball
item.description: Ayva Wilkins knocked in the go-ahead run in the bottom of the sixth inning, and one day after pitching a no-hitter, Riley Ward took the circle for the save in Manteca’s 2-1 win over visiting Kimball on Tuesday.

item.title: EU comeback falls short in semifinal loss to Beyer
item.description: The East Union Lancers erased a 13-point lead in the second half but saw their run to a Sac-Joaquin Section Division III title end Tuesday night in a 55-53 semifinal loss to Beyer of Modesto.

item.title: Lancers charge toward 1st section final since ’94
item.description: At long last, Danelle Liles and the rest of the 1994 East Union girls basketball team has company. The 2025-26 Lancers have become just the second group in program history to reach a Sac-Joaquin Section final after they knocked off previously-undefeated Lathrop 47-37 inside a jam-packed Dalben Center on Tuesday.

item.title: Using smartphone to get the time isn’t better than dialing POPCORN if we just squander it
item.description: Back in the Dark Ages before people took a byte out of the Apple, if you didn’t have a watch or there wasn’t a wall clock around with a big hand and a small hand and you needed to know what time it was, you’d ask Ma.

item.title: Free tutoring benefits from Tip-a-Firefighter at Applebee’s
item.description: Manteca firefighters local 1874 IAFF is supporting the Give Every Child a Chance free tutoring program on Wednesday, Feb. 25, by playing host to the annual Tip-A-Firefighter at Applebee’s Bar & Grill, 1272 E. Yosemite Ave., today, from 5 to 9 p.m.

item.title: Response times to Priority One police calls cut 24 seconds
item.description: Manteca Police in 2025 reduced their response times to Priority One calls — where a life is in danger or a felony is in progress — by 23 seconds.

item.title: MANTECA ENCOURAGES INFILL
item.description: New housing starts in established neighborhoods in Manteca hit a record 143 housing units in 2025.

item.title: MANTECA’S POET LAUREATE: CONNECTING COMMUNITY
item.description: Tara Rico connects people with themselves — and the community. And she does so through the power of words.
